# KothaPad Permanent Android Signing Key Backup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHY THIS EXISTS:
# When you import your GitHub repo into another Google AI Studio account,
# this Base64 string is used to decode the exact same `debug.keystore`.
# This ensures Android will ALWAYS let you install updates over existing
# versions without "Signature conflict" / "App not installed" errors.
#
# INSTRUCTIONS IF YOU SWITCH TO A NEW GOOGLE ID:
# If you ever create or import a project in a new Google account and get a signature conflict,
# ensure a file named `debug.keystore.base64` exists in the root directory containing
# ONLY the key string below.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
